title: Rust Structs
learning_objectives: Define named-field structs and choose appropriate field types.
Initialize structs and access or update their fields.
Add and call methods that operate on struct instances.
Distinguish public and private struct fields when designing a small API.
explanation: Structs group related data into a named type. Named fields make the data readable, mutable fields can be updated when an instance is mutable, and methods provide behavior alongside the data. Visibility controls which fields callers can access directly.

examples.title: Define and initialize a struct
Add a method
Keep implementation details private

compiler_error_examples: error[E0616]: field `display_name` of struct `Profile` is private
error[E0599]: no method named `summary` found for struct `Profile`
completion_criteria: Exercise tests cover profile construction, field access, method behavior, and an empty-name boundary case
Learner can explain how a method borrows a struct instance
Learner can identify why the private display field is not part of the public API
